basic_info.description: Experience urban elegance in this stunning North Beach condominium. This upper-level, 2-bedroom, 2-bath home has a private entrance and features an updated kitchen and bathrooms with sleek stainless steel appliances, an in unit washer and dryer, and charming bay windows that flood the space with natural light. The primary bedroom includes a private bathroom, and both bedrooms offer large walk in closets. Enjoy the spacious, bright private deck, perfect for relaxing and soaking up the sun. Located just steps from public transit, Trader Joe's, Washington Square, Joe DiMaggio Playground, the North Beach Library & Pool, Butter & Crumble, Hilda & Jesse, Flour + Water Pizzeria, Bar April Jean, and the other iconic restaurants on Columbus Avenue.  This property combines convenience with sophistication. Don't miss the opportunity to own an exceptional residence in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
